code:
Contacts failed in bulk:
INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_KEY

-- Cause: Accounts and Contacts loaded together
-- Fix: load Accounts first, confirm success,
--      THEN load Contacts referencing those Ids.
caption: A sequencing problem, not a data problem — the classic parent-before-child fix.

code:
12,000 source rows
  -> 340 duplicates flagged for review
  -> ~60 reused legacy IDs corrected
  -> 11,600 clean Account records
  -> one checklist, adopted for every future load
caption: No single tool did this — the whole course's toolkit, run in sequence.

subtitle: Clean data is what makes the next report leadership asks for actually mean something.
